name: bandit.phase5_visible_burn_producer_mcw
description: Non-credit Phase-5 producer/calibration run. A current quiet five-member bandit camp receives one fixture-known terrain-opportunity lead at the real player camp, then production must choose a bounded watch route and dispatch an exact structural pair into observing within one three-hour wait. The run saves that authoritative owner for coordinator inspection and requires direct confirmation of schema_version 10 plus selected_watch_omt before any derived credited run; it does not stage or claim burn, ordinary visibility, observer rendering, incident capture, or an ecology outcome.

steps.label: settle_phase5_visible_burn_producer
steps.abort_reason: the current-schema producer fixture did not reach normal gameplay
steps.expected_visible_fact: the non-credit producer reaches normal gameplay before any simulation time advances

steps.label: preflight_phase5_player_camp_producer
steps.abort_reason: fixture did not contain exactly five ready members, no active outing, and the sole exact player-camp terrain opportunity
steps.expected_immediate_state: five ready members and one fixture-known player-camp target are idle; production has not chosen a route, watch, pair, or outcome

steps.label: record_phase5_burn_producer_turn
steps.expected_visible_fact: the hour-139 producer baseline is recorded before the bounded wait

steps.label: wait_three_hours_for_phase5_schema10_observer_pair
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: the real wait menu opens before choosing the single three-hour producer window
steps.expected_visible_fact: one bounded three-hour window lets production select geography, dispatch the exact pair, and advance it toward the selected watch
steps.failure_rule: If production does not dispatch the exact fixture-known target in this window, preserve the producer artifacts but do not create a calibration fixture.

steps.label: audit_exact_phase5_player_camp_dispatch
steps.abort_reason: same-run production logs did not contain the exact player-camp structural dispatch
steps.expected_immediate_state: production, not the fixture, owns one exact pair and its selected watch route

steps.label: audit_phase5_burn_producer_mtime_before_save
steps.expected_visible_fact: the player-save mtime baseline is recorded before producer writeback

steps.label: open_phase5_burn_producer_save_prompt
steps.abort_reason: the case-sensitive save-and-quit prompt was not visibly proven
steps.expected_visible_fact: the final producer save-and-quit prompt is open

steps.label: confirm_phase5_burn_producer_save
steps.expected_visible_fact: uppercase Y confirms the producer save

steps.label: audit_phase5_burn_producer_mtime_after_save
steps.abort_reason: the player save mtime did not advance after save-and-quit
steps.expected_visible_fact: the same-run authoritative producer state is written to disk

steps.label: audit_saved_phase5_schema10_observing_pair
steps.abort_reason: saved producer state did not retain the exact generation-1 structural pair in observing on the player-camp target
steps.expected_immediate_state: saved owner contains the natural current-code pair for coordinator-only schema_version and selected_watch_omt calibration

evidence_contract.claim: non-credit producer/calibration only: production selected and saved one exact observing structural pair against fixture-known real player-camp target footing
evidence_contract.setup_boundary: the fixture injects one known terrain-opportunity target, deliberately restages the player clock to hour 139 as deterministic calibration setup rather than natural elapsed play, and adds DEBUG_CLAIRVOYANCE; it does not inject discovery, route, watch, dispatch, pair ownership, burn, observer selection, incident, or outcome
evidence_contract.coordinator_calibration: Inspect the captured authoritative save for active_outing.schema_version == 10 and selected_watch_omt before deriving any credited visible-burn scenario.
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: producer footing only / no Phase-5 burn or observer credit
evidence_contract.failure_rule: Do not credit burn, reciprocal visibility, egress, rally, observer rendering, or incident evidence from this producer. If saved phase is not observing or schema/watch inspection is invalid, discard the calibration output.
